# Pretext 0.0.9

Locally bundled MIT-licensed browser modules from `@chenglou/pretext` 0.0.9.
Source: https://github.com/chenglou/pretext. License: `LICENSE`.
The exact npm version and integrity are pinned in `../../package-lock.json`.
Reproduce with `npm ci --ignore-scripts` in the web directory, then copy the
six top-level JavaScript modules used by `layout.js` and `generated/bidi-data.js`.
Only text measurement is used; the game continues to use bundled Three.js.
